text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Event 1, signed-MW group. MW is power drawn from the Primary. Black: actual. Blue line: forecast median. Blue band: 5% to 95% interval. Grey band: the labelled event. From the start onwards: the run 23.5 hours before the start (no run exists 24 hours before); earlier half-hours: the run 24 hours before each (the latest earlier run if none). Events not in the label table may also be present.'
text.tspan: Event 1, signed-MW group. MW is power drawn from the Primary. Black: actual. Blue line: forecast median.
Blue band: 5% to 95% interval. Grey band: the labelled event. From the start onwards: the run 23.5 hours
before the start (no run exists 24 hours before); earlier half-hours: the run 24 hours before each (the
latest earlier run if none). Events not in the label table may also be present.
